q: 6. The project risk that will encounter due to earthquake in which both contracting parties are unable to control the situation is ......
explain: Force majeure covers events like earthquakes beyond the control of both contracting parties.
Supervision supports many activities and cannot be charged to one item, so it is an indirect cost.
Insurance covers the whole project, so it is an indirect cost.
A fixed cost can be direct or indirect depending on whether it can be traced to a specific item.
A variable cost can be direct or indirect.
